description: A network of four hosts: a, b, r and c. Link la joins a and r, link lb joins b and r, and link lc joins r and c. Links la and lb each carry {la.rate} with a one-way delay of {la.delay}; link lc carries {lc.rate} with a one-way delay of {lc.delay}. Flow fa is TCP from a to c: it always has data to send, and its congestion control is {fa.type}. Flow fb is UDP from b to c: packets of {fb.packet_bytes} bytes at a constant rate ({fb.rate}). A host with more than one link forwards packets. Each host sends a packet along the route with the fewest links to the packet's destination; the routes are worked out once, before traffic starts, and do not change during a simulation. On r's side of lc, packets wait in one queue of {lc.queue.length} packets, first in, first out, and a packet that arrives when it is full is dropped; every other side of a link has a plain queue of 100 packets. In each simulation the flows start within the first 10 ms, traffic runs for one second that is not measured, and then for duration seconds, over which the outputs are measured.

lc.queue.length.meaning: most packets the queue on r's side of link lc holds

fa.type.meaning: TCP congestion control of flow fa
